Learn with complete Hop projects: small datasets, ready-to-run pipelines, actual GUI screenshots and checked results. Download a project once, then follow its tutorials.

## Vector Raster plugin {#vector-raster}

The [Vector Raster plugin](plugins.qmd#vector-raster) handles spatial files and typed raster values. Choose a series:

::: {.column width="50%"}
### Vector formats

Read three sample points and export six formats. Explore schema, encoding, layers and format limitations.

[Browse six vector tutorials](examples/vector-formats.qmd){.btn .btn-primary}

### Raster processing

Read, inspect, clip, reproject and write rasters, then calculate building-height statistics from the 2019 nDSM. Six tutorials, eight pipelines and 33 building polygons only.

[Browse six raster tutorials](examples/raster-processing.qmd){.btn .btn-primary}

[Download raster project](downloads/raster-processing.zip)
:::
:::

Seven raster pipelines run offline; the eighth demonstrates the same statistics using a public online COG. Each series documents its own tested setup and expected results.
